description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutablePayload' implementing 'Payload', with methods for creating, parsing from JSON, and serializing to JSON. It includes nested builder class for constructing instances and handles various payload attributes like path, value, extra data, status, revision, timestamp, metadata, and fields.

classes.name: ImmutablePayload
classes.description: Immutable implementation of Payload with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and equality checks.

classes.name: ImmutablePayload.ImmutablePayloadBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing ImmutablePayload instances, supporting fluent API.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating ImmutablePayload instances with a specified path.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutablePayload instance from a JSON object, extracting fields and handling missing required fields.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload's value.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing extra JSON data.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the HTTP status code.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the revision number.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JSON field selector.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the payload to a JSON object.
